trigger: Founder correction: Don't blame Python. Why would you render my visual example like this.
finding: LEVEL 5 FAIL — prior final assurance retracted
responsibility: Assistant execution decision failed the Founder prompt. Python did not cause the visual failure.
root_execution_error: The assistant consciously simplified the requested visual set and selected image crops instead of preserving the requirement for independently rendered standalone visuals.

After image generation returned infographic/collage boards, the assistant used Python to crop, stitch, upscale, and duplicate those failed boards into twelve files rather than rejecting the boards and re-rendering twelve compliant standalone scenes.

The assistant then treated file-count/RGB/nonblank/hash checks as visual-control validation even though those checks did not test whether each image was an independently generated, Founder-faithful, standalone rendering.
The GitHub final Mirror Review repeated the same false premise and incorrectly recorded HOLDS.
retractions: RETRACT verification/REFRESHED_AND_REINVIGORATED_FINAL_12_RENDERING_MANIFEST_2026-09-27.json as evidence of visual compliance. Preserve as failed-work provenance only.
RETRACT mirror-reviews/REFRESHED_AND_REINVIGORATED_FINAL_MIRROR_REVIEW_2026-09-27.json final_assurance HOLDS. Preserve as historical failed review only.
REJECT both infographic/collage generated candidates and every crop/composite/stitched/repeated-sprite derivative made from them as non-controlling, non-approved, and not valid deliverables.
corrected_execution_control: Python is a verification layer only for this visual workflow: prompt checks, counts, hashes, image dimensions, and comparison support. Python must not be used to convert a failed collage/board into purported standalone final renderings.
A failed image-generation output remains failed; it must not become source material for final visual creation unless the Founder explicitly selects it as a reference/source.
The twelve required visuals must each be independently generated as a full-size standalone photorealistic/cinematic rendering, not extracted from one board and not stitched from multiple panels.
No collage, infographic, concept board, contact sheet, multi-scene strip, repeated-sprite fleet construction, or caption/specification board counts toward the twelve.

Each rendering must be visually compared against the current Founder prompt, inherited controls, exact counts, assigned accessibility classes, palette, identity, Common Area controls, fleet interiors/exteriors, and frozen Founder-provided reference features when such a reference is supplied.
Only after the actual image content passes Mirror Review may Python verify technical properties and GitHub record the pass.
